# H3 4D Spacetime Tensor Fabric
> Multi-dimensional planetary digital twin indexing telemetry across [Latitude, Longitude, Depth/Altitude, Time].

## For Autonomous Geospatial & Physical Reasoning Agents
Stop downloading multi-gigabyte flat spatial catalogs to find events within a specific space-time envelope.

This repository hierarchically indexes planetary telemetry into discrete 4D tensor buckets:
`[H3_Cell_Resolution_6 : Depth_Altitude_Layer : Hourly_Time_Bucket]`

### Direct HTTP Byte-Range Querying (DuckDB)
Query exact bounding boxes remotely without downloading the full dataset:
```python
import duckdb

conn = duckdb.connect()
url = "https://{owner}.github.io/H3-4D-Spacetime-Tensor/spacetime.parquet"

# Zero local file download: pulls only targeted Parquet byte chunks via HTTP range requests
results = conn.execute(f"""
    SELECT h3_index, magnitude, depth_altitude_layer, time_bucket_utc
    FROM '{url}'
    WHERE magnitude >= 4.0 AND depth_altitude_layer = 'CRUST_SHALLOW'
""").fetchall()
